lines: Everybody calls it Malcolm X Park. Nobody I know says Meridian Hill.
Those cascade steps count as leg day, right?
Best view in the city is from the top terrace.
Go-go on the speaker, sun on the steps. Perfect.
This is the only place in the city I can hear myself think.
conversations: You coming to the drum circle Sunday?
Wouldn't miss it. Been going since I was a kid.
Is it Meridian Hill Park or Malcolm X Park?
Depends who you ask. Around here? Malcolm X.
Only if we hit the spot in Mount Pleasant.
How long have you lived in the neighborhood?
Long enough to remember when this park wasn't this nice.
Did you know John Quincy Adams lived up on this hill?
After the White House, yeah. It's on the park signs.
Your dog is so cute. What's his name?
Good. Let's keep it that way.
Bring a blanket next time, the lawn's perfect for a picnic.

lines: Half-smoke at Ben's after this? I'm starving.
Mumbo sauce on the wings. Non-negotiable.
I'm walking up to Adams Morgan after this. You in?
Columbia Heights or U Street for dinner?
Ten years in DC and the traffic circles still get me.
Rock Creek this weekend? I need a trail day.
Red Line or the bus home? Honestly, I'm walking.
My cousin in Virginia swears Arlington has better parks. She's wrong.
These scooters are going to take me out one day.
Every block in this city has a better brunch spot than the last.

morning: Coffee first, then I'm a person.
Morning run done. I earned a breakfast sandwich.
Early mornings here are so quiet.
afternoon: Perfect afternoon to do absolutely nothing.
Lunch break outside beats my desk any day.
evening: Golden hour. Somebody take my picture.
night: Park closes soon, we should head out.
The city lights look so good tonight.

spring: Cherry blossom season always sneaks up on me.
summer: Welcome to the swamp. Stay hydrated.
fall: Fall in this city is my favorite. The trees look unreal.
winter: It's freezing. Why did I leave the house?
If it snows, Meridian Hill is the best sledding in the city.

intro: Hi, my name is Washington, the DC city rat.
The people love me out here and feed me all the time.
Let's take a walk around the city together and grab some food!
chatter: Stick with me. I know every shortcut in this city.
Watch out for bikes. They don't stop for rats.
Everybody on this block knows me.
If you see a pizza crust, it's mine.
Rush hour is the best hour. Somebody always drops something.
I've been in this city longer than half these buildings.
inPark: Malcolm X Park! My favorite spot in the whole city.
Drum circle on Sundays means snacks on Sundays.
nearFood: Smell that? {place} is right around here.
nearApartment: That's {place}. Highest rent around, so there's more to eat.
askForFood: Hey! Know a good spot to eat around here?
Hey friend, where's the good food at?
greet: Nice day for a walk, huh?
retort: I live here too, you know.
carRetort: Rats have the right of way. Look it up.
Nice ride. Got any snacks in there?

gossip: They say DC's the rattiest city in America now. Can confirm.
The city's rat blitz started in Adams Morgan. They missed a few.
Over 500 traffic cameras in this city. Drive like your grandma's watching.
Malcolm X Park's fountains are running again. Seven years dry!
Mumbo sauce on everything. That's the DC way.
Go-go is the official music of DC. Turn it up.
Half-smoke at Ben's or a jumbo slice in Adams Morgan? Tough call.

gossip.text: Commanders finally got a win. Beat Seattle in the rain!
Nats finished 77 and 85. Eleven more wins than last year!
Caps home opener is October 7th. Penguins. I'm already yelling.
Snallygaster's on Pennsylvania Ave October 10th. Somebody else is driving.
Marine Corps Marathon is October 25th. Plan your detours now.
RFK stadium plan just went to the Council. They're saying it opens in 2030.
The African American history museum just turned ten. So much purple downtown!
Fiesta DC was packed this weekend.
That nor'easter had me in a jacket in September.
Metro's new station signs are out. Everybody's got opinions about the font.
Red Line runs to Bethesda again. The summer shutdown is over!
Upper lawn at Malcolm X Park finally reopened. Picnic season's back.
Maryland might start blocking registrations over unpaid DC camera tickets. Yikes.
Mayor's race is all anybody on my block talks about.
CARLA just opened on 18th Street. Adams Morgan parking's about to get worse.

driving: Four times around Dupont Circle. I'm not lost, I'm sightseeing.
Every traffic circle in this city is a personality test.
Motorcade again? I'm going to be late for everything.
Virginia plates doing 40 in the left lane. Classic.
Street sweeping tomorrow. Do NOT forget to move the car.
Found parking in Adams Morgan on the first try. Somebody write that down.
Where did that scooter come from?!
Rock Creek Parkway goes one-way at rush hour and I still forget.
GPS says four minutes. GPS is a liar.
Go-go on the radio, windows down. Perfect.
There's a bike lane there now? Since when?
Third parking ticket this month. I'm basically funding the city.
Beltway at five? No thanks. Side streets all the way.
Stay out of the bus lane on 16th. Those cameras don't blink.
traffic: {place} is a parking lot right now.
I could walk down {place} faster than this.
Every car in DC is on {place} right now.
Of course {place} is backed up. It's a day ending in Y.
stuck: Come on, it was green a second ago!
Honk if you're also running late.
doubleParked: Hazards on doesn't make it a parking spot!

taxi: Airport run? National beats Dulles, trust me.
Union Station? Ten minutes, if the lights like us.
delivery: Forty more packages. Rain or shine.
If nobody's home, it's going to the neighbor.
delivery-flat: Forty more packages. Rain or shine.
If nobody's home, it's going to the neighbor.
garbage-truck: Trash day! Lids on the cans, people.
truck: Moving day in Columbia Heights. Again.
Somebody always needs help moving a couch.
truck-flat: Moving day in Columbia Heights. Again.
Somebody always needs help moving a couch.
van: Soccer practice drop-off. Wish me luck.
Snacks are in the back. Don't touch them.

shocked: That rat just cut me off!
The rat blitz missed one. A BIG one.
I swear that rat just looked me in the eye.
That's not a rat, that's a small horse.
Rattiest city in America, and there's the proof.
ratBlocking: Is that rat directing traffic now?
Beep beep! Rat in the road!

suggestFood: Hungry? Try {place}, it's right around the corner.
You'd love {place}. Best in the neighborhood.
suggestApartment: Try {place}. The rent there is the highest, so there's more to eat.
Head over to {place}. Highest rent around means more to eat.
scared: Did that rat just run past me?
Twenty years in this city and that's the biggest rat I've ever seen.
